snippet.title: The Grimm Reapress and the Drearytale Monster - Release Date Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Step into a hand-drawn fairytale, one book at a time in The Grimm Reapress and the Drearytale Monster. In this world brought to you by the team behind Liar Princess and the Blind Prince, a magical disease known as Paper Mortis turns people into picture books, and picture books into monsters.

Featuring stunning art and a poignant, tragic tale, The Grimm Reapress and the Drearytale Monster follows Mono, a young girl whose sister contracts this horrible malady. She’ll do whatever it takes to save her sister from an incurable illness—including working with a monster hell-bent on vengeance.

The Grimm Reapress and the Drearytale Monster will be releasing for Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, PlayStation 5, and PC on May 13, 2027!

Follow @NISAmerica on X, Instagram, and Facebook for updates!

Learn more @ https://nisamerica.com/grimm-reapress/
